transcript:
anna: Heads-up — I kicked off a small recompute for EU hourly aggs and the console kept the job artifacts for 90d. The replay generated ~120GB of temporary parquet under /recompute/tmp and bumped S3 costs. We should tighten retention + add console safeguards. :grimacing:
sandeep: Oof. Which job id? can we see a quick estimate before runs?
anna: job id 2023-RECOMP-841. I hit the 'run now' path in the console. No preview estimate was shown.
felix: We should add a preflight that 1) shows estimated output size 2) shows expected shard concurrency and time 3) warns if > X GB. :thinking:
maria: agreed. also we have a `dry_run=true` option in the internal API that returns row counts. We can wire that into the UI. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.recompute/api/v1/replay 
  -d '{"query":"...","preview":true}'
```
ops-bot: job 2023-RECOMP-841 started by anna — queued on dedicated-replay-pool.
thomas: long-term: default artifact retention should be shorter. 90d is extreme for ephemeral recompute outputs. propose default 7d and tenant-level opt-in for longer.
sandeep: +1. Also add a quota check on the POST route that blocks > 100GB unless flagged by a privileged role. We accidentally let self-serve runs exhaust bucket quotas before.
felix: UX idea: a modal that requires typing the tenant slug + an explicit checkbox for "retain artifacts >7d" when requested. That will slow down accidental clicks. :point_up:
maria: API change is small — expose `estimated_bytes` and `estimated_row_count` from preview. We should also return a simple cost estimate in USD.
anna: For operator handoff, we need a console view that surfaces these large replays so SRE/Finance can triage charges quickly. Maybe a dedicated "replay audit" feed.
thomas: Re: throttling — we've previously used a token bucket per-tenant for backfills. We can add a burst limit and a longer cooldown window for tenants that hit the cap.
sandeep: SLA concern: if replays are throttled too aggressively, downstream dashboards will show stale aggregates. We need a canary path for urgent replays (ops-approved).
felix: implementation plan: phase 1 = preview endpoint wired to UI + modal + conservative defaults (7d retention, 100GB hard cap), phase 2 = quota UI and admin override, phase 3 = audit feed + cost alerting. Anyone want to pick up phase1?
maria: I can mock the UI for the modal and add the preview call.
anna: amazing. can you also include the cancel button visible during job enqueue? We had no easy cancel for that job.
maria: will do.
ops-bot: job 2023-RECOMP-841 finished — produced 118.9GB, duration 47m.
sandeep: Can we auto-archive large artifacts to infrequent-tier S3 after 48h to avoid hot storage charges?
thomas: autarchiving makes sense but keep lifecycle visible in the console. default auto-archive to IA after 24h for >10GB outputs.
felix: I'll spin up an RFC doc later today with endpoints, schema changes, and console mocks. Short checklist: preview API, modal/confirm, default retention 7d, 100GB soft cap + admin override, audit feed, auto-archive rule.
anna: Sounds good. Add a short migration note for existing 90d artifacts — we should start a one-off cleanup for anything older than 30d unless flagged.
maria: I'll add that to the UX tickets and include example copy for the modal.
sandeep: +1 on cleanup. schedule operator-run next week.
anna: ok looping in finance and SRE in a follow-up thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
